unlisted_practices: Using tool-augmented agentic AI to learn from prior field-experiment data to generate improved patient prescription messaging interventions
Auditing behavioral theories for intervention design at field-experiment scale using agentic AI
Two-stage sequential field experiments comparing human-plus-chatbot versus agentic AI message design

screen.reason: The study conducts a real-world field experiment (A/B testing prescription messages sent to patients) to test a tool-augmented agentic AI method for automated intervention design against a human-plus-chatbot design method.
